body:
: A Libertarian would probably say; "Sure, never trust _anyone_, always
: rely on yourself, and screw them over before they screw you over."
:
: I pity Libertarians.  What a pathetic way to go through life, always
: seeking to increase their own materialistic urges at the expense of
: others.  How many televisions you need, Mr. Libertarian? How many
: cable t.v. channels can you watch at once?  Just because Ayn Rand
: despises emotion doesn't mean you shouldn't give it a try...
:
: Along with the lose of emotions such as compassion, pity,  and guilt,
: you lose emotions such as love. empathy, and romance.
 
I think you're right about a lot of the Rand-clones but those are
just sheep looking for another master to give them orders.  They need
a dogma to define themselves with and "Objectivism" or Libertarianism
fits the bill conveniently.

There's something to their anti-emotional perspective though.  When
you look around at the predatory nature of all business, how can you
have compassion, pity, guilt, love, empathy, or romance for anything
related to capitalism.  It's all a show for your money.  In a
capitalistic society, we can have any plastic junk good for a "low"
price, but we pay the higher cost in our brutally inhumane relationships
with each other that are irreconcilably tainted by the same capitalistic
psychology.

"Is she only being nice to me because she wants my money like the salesmen?"
"Is he only being nice to me because he wants sex and then he'll skip out?"
"If I do x, she'll have to do y!"

The strategy for taking advantage of others is all that matters.  We see
each other as consumable products just like everything else in society,
so why not take advantage?  If we royally screw someone over, then we'll
just go to the store and get another.  Capitalistic society has taught
us to approach things that way, so we're "just following orders".

"I need a friend who likes x."
"One of my friends can get me y."
"I like her because she's z and my last friend was z."

Still, whatever you say about the Libertarians, they always seem to be  
nice and help me find the right book from their complex shelving system.
I need to buy one of those...
    
-Ric G.
"The conservatives are fools: They whine about the decay of traditional 
 values, yet they enthusiastically support technological progress and 
 economic growth." -FC, Industrial_Society_and_its_Future [50]
